unit.why: This division is homiletic. It gives a kavvanah for chewing (the name חב"ו) and an exegesis of 'ועתה ישראל' and 'אשא עיני אל ההרים' attributed to the author's father as a humble saying, without any narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: The father's teaching breaks off mid-sentence ('א״כ גם אנכי לא') and continues beyond this division; the next division opens with a footnote.
